title: Where slavery money came home
excerpt: When Britain ended colonial slavery it paid £20 million to the slave-owners and nothing to the people they had enslaved. I mapped 3,187 British addresses of the owners and claimants: 36% of them in London.
seo_description: Mapping 3,187 British addresses of slave-owners compensated at abolition in the 1830s: 36% in London, by county per head.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'Where slavery money came home' beside a map of Great Britain with counties shaded brown, darkest around London, and the figure 36% in London.
